notes.title: Small Update: Fixed upgrade screen bug
notes.notes: Just a small update, you weren't able to pick some of the upgrades in the upgrade screen but that is now fixed!

notes.title: Update: Death animations, difficulty affects health
notes.notes:
Today's update covers 3 main things:

- difficulty affecting health
- death animations
- explanation for how to get gems

[b]Difficulty changing health[/b]

The difficulty scaling on health is as follows. 
Easy = -20% enemy health
Medium = no change
Hard = +20% enemy health

This is meant to make more of a difference between the difficulties, making easy much more accessible to new players and giving a better challenge to hard. 

[b]Death animations: [/b]

We also implemented death animations so the enemies no longer disappear instantly upon losing all of their health, this just looks a lot better than them disappearing. We're going to experiment with more fun animations but this is the first step!

[b]Explanation for how to get gems[/b]

We added an explanation on how to get gems in-game. This should make it much more clear to players as to what they can do to get more gems. Explanation below:

Easy - all lives remaining = 3 Green Gems
Easy - 50-99% lives remaining = 2 Green Gems
Easy - 1-50% lives remaining = 1 Green Gem

Medium - all lives remaining = 6 Green Gems
Medium - 50-99% lives remaining = 4 Green Gems
Medium - 1-50% lives remaining = 2 Green Gems

Hard - all lives remaining = 3 Red Gems
Hard - 50-99% lives remaining = 2 Red Gems
Hard - 1-50% lives remaining = 1 Red Gem

*Note: You will not get gems you already received. So, let's say you played level 1 on easy and got 2 gems. If you played again and got 2 gems, you wouldn't gain any. If you played that same level and got 3 stars, you'd get 1 gem gained as you didn't get that third gem yet.

notes.title: Update: Fixed lightning tower
notes.notes: Lightning tower has been fixed and the lightning properly comes out of the tower. We are working now to add more animations and sound effects when things happen in-game!

notes.title: Update: Tower Descriptions and live tower stats!
notes.notes: We've been getting a lot of feedback and we really appreciate all of it! One of the most common things we've heard is that people want to know what each tower does, and your tower's current stats. We have implemented that into the game and we'll keep working to make Endorfire Tower Defense more fun for everyone!
